releases.body:
Intake hardening + unified model config:

- PM-1 intake follow-ups (#9): single env-parametrized Jev path, opencode-only (gateway + Zen), JSON model variables (OPENCODE_MODEL/JEV_MODEL: cli + apiBase), provider-aware keys, fail-closed routing, curl/browser UA for Cloudflare 1010
- Probes: jev-probe (gateway/Zen, UA fix, fail-closed validation), chat-probe (Go endpoint + x-opencode-session)
- replay workflow (manual calibration, keyword+Jev policies, defaults to #9 issue set)
- llm-judge: JSON model var, Go session header, guarded JSON parsing
- Verified live: Jev free noul=0.91, chat beam OK; replay thresholds match #9 calibration
